revisions.summary: Bootstrap separate installed-runtime and repository-policy identities with deterministic runtime digest validation.
Add fixed credential-lifecycle routing and source-contract validation alongside the composed installed Skill protocol.
Add fixed release-readiness routing and source-contract validation alongside the on-demand installed Skill audit.
Define and enforce the public documentation information architecture with canonical ownership, lifecycle boundaries, and standard-library validation.
Establish only the no-Hook profile contract with versioned cases, host-scoped capabilities, immutable artifact bindings, and static validation; no derived runtime is built.
Add the deterministic no-Hook derived bundle builder, three-layer identity, and static evidence without changing or publishing the installed full profile.
